before.decline_sentence: A note on what I have not interpreted: the classical texts I work from do not clearly address the following as they appear in your hands: fate line, sun line, thumb, fingers, mount of saturn, mount of apollo, mount of mercury, mount of mars negative, mount of luna. Rather than guess, I have left these out of your reading.
